prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1194; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection. Complaints included neck pain with stiffness, mid and low back pain, and muscle tenderness over the cervical and lumbar paraspinal regions. Pain was rated moderate at initial presentation. No loss of consciousness was reported, and no head strike was described.

Examination revealed decreased cervical range of motion, particularly with rotation and extension, along with palpable muscle guarding in the trapezius and lumbar paraspinals. Neurological screening was intact, with normal strength, sensation, and reflexes in the upper and lower extremities. Imaging was not indicated at this time based on clinical findings.

Diagnoses were cervical strain and lumbar strain secondary to the collision. The patient was treated with soft tissue mobilization, a home stretching program, and over-the-counter anti-inflammatory medication as needed.

Two office visits were completed. At the second visit, the patient reported partial improvement in neck and back symptoms and improved range of motion. Activity modification was advised, with a plan to return to usual activities as tolerated and to seek care if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
